cross_source_content_pool_scope.scope: pool: C4 shards 0-7 (2,850,538), full FineWeb file (1,048,581), WET (175,272); not the 700k/1M main subsets

wet_c4.relation: WET segments are CC-MAIN-2019-18, the crawl from which C4 was built; WET is the pre-extraction, pre-filter conversion record, not a copy of C4
wet_c4.note: 147 pairs over 8 of 1,024 C4 shards; a lower bound on coverage

official_pairing_set.relation: the 38,472 English documents are a language/score subset of the same 175,272 WET documents, not independent data
official_pairing_set.exact_truth_scope: full 175,272-document WET snapshot, project tokeniser; the official run sees 38,472 with datatrove's SpaCy tokeniser
official_pairing_set.official_language_filter: lang == 'en' and lang_score >= 0.8 (DATA.md; the code docstring default 0.99 was not the run value)

val_clean.relation: random sample of the same 700,000-document C4 corpus, np seed 0, excluded from every dedup arm; a same-corpus held-out split, NOT an independent corpus

pairing_set.relation: subset of WET (same documents), not a renamed copy of C4

d1_lsh_only_removed.relation: documents removed only by raw LSH from the same C4 sample; same corpus, different deletion policy

main_subset_relations.fw: main FineWeb 1,000,000 is the first 1,000,000 of the pool's 1,048,581 rows of the same file
main_subset_relations.c4: main C4 700,000 is the first 700,000 of the pool's 2,850,538 documents (shards 0-7)

pool_scope.note: the largest LSH cluster (1,974 documents) spans C4 and FineWeb: 1,972 C4 documents plus 2 FineWeb documents, which is itself cross-source evidence in the pool

headline.mix_relation: first half is exactly FineWeb rows 0-499,999; second half is exactly C4 documents 0-499,999
headline.why: WET is the same crawl as C4 at a different processing stage; val_clean is a held-out split of the same C4 sample; the pairing set is a subset of WET; Mix is a concatenation of C4 and FineWeb. No corpus in the main table is independent of the others.
headline.consequence: cross-corpus contrasts (C4 vs FineWeb vs Mix vs WET) measure processing stage and duplicate density, not independent replication; Mix must be labelled as an overlap of C4 and FineWeb, and WET as the same crawl as C4.
